Total: 1 hour|difficulty=2 }} {{recipe|Brownies, Brown Sugar}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] ==Ingredients== * 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] packed [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|light brown sugar]] * ½ cup (1 stick) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]], softened * 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (2 squares) unsweetened [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]], melted * ½ cup [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]] * 1 cup coarsely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]] ==Procedure== # Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|325°F]]. # Grease an 8 x 8 x 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] square [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|baking pan]]. # [[Cookbook:Cream|Cream]] sugar and butter until fluffy. # [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] in eggs. # Beat in melted chocolate. # Mix in flour, then stir in nuts. # Pour into prepared pan. # [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] about 25 minutes. # Cool in pan, and cut into squares. == Notes, tips, and variations == * The brownies can also be baked in a [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]] at moderately slow heat instead of in the baking pan. {{DEFAULTSORT:Brownies, Brown Sugar}} [[Category:Inexpensive recipes]] [[Category:United States recipes]] [[Category:Recipes for brownies]] [[Category:Recipes using unsweetened chocolate]] [[Category:Recipes using walnut]] [[Category:Baking recipes]] [[Category:Vegetarian recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using butter]] [[Category:Recipes using egg]] [[Category:Recipes for bars]] [[Category:Recipes using light brown sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using all-purpose flour]] [[Category:Recipes using margarine]]
